content.text: carbamazepine may stimulate vasopressin release but is inferior to desmopressin, so it's seldom used.

Boxed: serious and sometimes fatal dermatologic reactions incl TEN and SJS reported during tx; estimated 1 to 6 per 10,000 new users in mainly Caucasian populations, ~10x higher in some Asian countries. Boxed: screen pts w/ ancestry in genetically at-risk populations for HLA-B*1502 b4 starting; pts testing positive should ⍉ be treated unless the benefit clearly outweighs the risk. Boxed: aplastic anemia and agranulocytosis reported; risk 5 to 8 times greater than in the general population. Boxed: obtain complete pretreatment hematological testing as a baseline; monitor closely if WBC or platelet counts are low/decreased; consider discontinuing if significant bone marrow depression develops. CI: Hx of previous bone marrow depression, hypersensitivity to the drug, or known sensitivity to any tricyclic compounds. CI: coadministration w/ nefazodone. DRESS/multiorgan hypersensitivity occurred, some fatal; if such signs/symptoms are present, evaluate immediately and discontinue if an alternative etiology cannot be established. AEDs incl Tegretol ↑ risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior; monitor for emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, and/or unusual changes in mood or behavior. Hyponatremia (often SIADH) can occur; risk appears dose-related; elderly pts and pts on diuretics are at greater risk. Rare anaphylaxis and angioedema (larynx, glottis, lips, eyelids) reported; angioedema w/ laryngeal edema can be fatal; discontinue and start alternative tx; ⍉ rechallenge. May render hormonal contraceptives less effective; breakthrough bleeding and unintended pregnancies reported; consider alternative or back-up contraception. Coadministration w/ rivaroxaban, apixaban, dabigatran, and edoxaban should be avoided (↓ anticoagulant plasma concentrations). OD: first signs/symptoms appear after 1 to 3 h; neuromuscular disturbances most prominent; severe cardiac complications occur only at very high doses (greater than 60 g). OD tx: prompt elimination of the drug is critical; induce vomiting, irrigate the stomach, and take steps to diminish absorption.
